en: The Sultanate of Banjar as an Islamic sultanate of the Banjar people in Borneo, founded in 1520
Raden Samudera's conversion to Islam in 1526 with the help of the Demak Sultanate and his name change to Sultan Suriansyah
Its capital mostly at Banjarmasin and for a time at Martapura
Its dissolution under Dutch colonial rule
zh: 班贾尔苏丹国是婆罗洲班贾尔人的伊斯兰苏丹国，1520年建立
1526年拉登·萨穆德拉在淡目苏丹国帮助下改宗伊斯兰教，改名苏丹苏里安夏
首都大部分时间在班贾尔马辛，一度迁至马塔普拉
后被荷兰殖民势力消灭

politics.zh: 班贾尔苏丹国是婆罗洲班贾尔人建立的伊斯兰苏丹国，1520年立国，位于今印度尼西亚南加里曼丹省。1526年，国王拉登·萨穆德拉在淡目苏丹国的帮助下改宗伊斯兰教，并改名苏丹苏里安夏，此后苏丹国以伊斯兰政权形式延续。首都大部分时间设在班贾尔马辛，一度迁至马塔普拉，最终被荷兰殖民势力消灭。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Banjar was an Islamic sultanate of the Banjar people in Borneo, founded in 1520 in what is now the province of South Kalimantan in Indonesia. In 1526 its king Raden Samudera embraced Islam with the help of the Demak Sultanate and took the name Sultan Suriansyah, after which the polity continued as an Islamic state. Its capital stood mostly at Banjarmasin and for a time at Martapura, and it was eventually destroyed by Dutch colonial power.

economy.zh: 苏丹国位于婆罗洲东南部，河流是交通与贸易的通道，胡椒、林产品、黄金与钻石是重要物产，班贾尔马辛的港口连接爪哇与东部群岛。
economy.en: The sultanate lay in south-eastern Borneo, where rivers served as routes for transport and trade and pepper, forest products, gold and diamonds were important goods, with the port of Banjarmasin linking Java and the eastern archipelago.

culture.zh: 班贾尔语是通用语言，伊斯兰制度与本地习俗结合，宫廷文学与马来语、爪夷文书写传统并存，苏丹国是加里曼丹伊斯兰文化的主要中心。
culture.en: Banjarese was the common language, Islamic institutions combined with local custom, and court literature existed alongside Malay and Jawi writing. The sultanate was a main centre of Islamic culture in Kalimantan. Its mosques and court manuscripts survive as evidence of that culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1520年立国、1526年改宗伊斯兰教、17至18世纪的区域影响，以及19世纪被荷兰殖民势力征服。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in 1520, the conversion to Islam in 1526, regional influence in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries and the conquest by Dutch colonial power in the nineteenth century. Dutch rule then ended the sultanate's independence.

value.zh: 1526年在淡目苏丹国帮助下改宗伊斯兰教。
value.en: It adopted Islam in 1526 with the help of the Demak Sultanate.

value.zh: 首都大部分时间在班贾尔马辛，一度迁至马塔普拉。
value.en: Its capital was mostly Banjarmasin, for a time Martapura.

en: The Blambangan Kingdom as the last Javanese Hindu kingdom, flourishing between the fifteenth and eighteenth centuries
Its base in the eastern corner of Java with its capital at Banyuwangi
Its contemporaneous development with Majapahit, the largest Hindu kingdom in Java
Its long history and eventual end under Dutch and Mataram pressure
zh: 布拉邦岸王国是爪哇最后一个印度教王国，15至18世纪兴盛
位于爪哇东端，首都在外南梦
与爪哇最大的印度教王国满者伯夷同时发展
历史延续甚久，最终在荷兰与马打蓝压力下终结

politics.zh: 布拉邦岸王国是爪哇最后一个印度教王国，15至18世纪间兴盛于爪哇东端，首都设在外南梦。它有独立的发展脉络，与爪哇最大的印度教王国满者伯夷（1293至1527年）同时存在；满者伯夷在15世纪末崩溃后，布拉邦岸继续维持印度教政权，直到18世纪在荷兰东印度公司与马打蓝势力的夹击下灭亡。
politics.en: The Blambangan Kingdom was the last Javanese Hindu kingdom, flourishing between the fifteenth and eighteenth centuries in the eastern corner of Java, with its capital at Banyuwangi. It had a history of its own and developed contemporaneously with Majapahit (1293-1527), the largest Hindu kingdom in Java; after Majapahit collapsed in the late fifteenth century Blambangan continued as a Hindu polity until it was destroyed in the eighteenth century under pressure from the Dutch East India Company and Mataram.

economy.zh: 王国位于爪哇东端，靠近巴厘海峡，农业与沿海贸易是经济基础，出口稻米与林产品，并参与与巴厘及东部群岛的往来。
economy.en: The kingdom lay at the eastern end of Java near the Bali Strait, where agriculture and coastal trade formed the economic base, with rice and forest products exported and exchange maintained with Bali and the eastern islands.

culture.zh: 布拉邦岸保持爪哇印度教-佛教传统，与已经伊斯兰化的爪哇中部与西部形成对比，其文化联系更多指向巴厘。，其居民与巴厘岛往来密切。
culture.en: Blambangan preserved Javanese Hindu-Buddhist traditions in contrast to the Islamised centre and west of Java. Its cultural links pointed rather towards Bali, and later Balinese memories of Javanese migration are connected with it. Balinese traditions preserve part of that heritage today.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪与满者伯夷并立、16至17世纪维持独立，以及18世纪在荷兰东印度公司与马打蓝的进攻下灭亡。
events.en: Key moments are its coexistence with Majapahit in the fifteenth century, its survival as an independent polity in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries and its destruction in the eighteenth under attacks by the Dutch East India Company and Mataram.

value.zh: 是爪哇最后一个印度教王国。
value.en: It was the last Javanese Hindu kingdom.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该政体的独立条目，叙述依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no separate article on this polity, so the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.

en: The Sultanate of Bima as a Muslim state in the eastern part of Sumbawa in Indonesia, at the site of the present Bima regency
Its official name, the Settlements and Lands of Mbojo, and its alternative name, the Kingdom of Bima
Its role as a regionally important polity forming the eastern limit of Islam in the area
zh: 比马苏丹国是印度尼西亚松巴哇岛东部的伊斯兰国家，位于今比马县
正式名称为姆博乔的居地与土地，又称比马王国
是区域重要政体，构成当地伊斯兰教的东界

politics.zh: 比马苏丹国正式名称为姆博乔的居地与土地，又称比马王国，是印度尼西亚松巴哇岛东部的伊斯兰国家，位于今比马县一带。它是区域内的重要政体，构成伊斯兰教在当地的东界，由苏丹统治，与周边岛屿和南苏拉威西的各王国保持往来。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Bima, officially the Settlements and Lands of Mbojo and alternatively the Kingdom of Bima, was a Muslim state in the eastern part of Sumbawa in Indonesia, at the site of the present-day Bima regency. It was a regionally important polity that formed the eastern limit of Islam in the area, ruled by a sultan and maintaining relations with neighbouring islands and the kingdoms of South Sulawesi.

economy.zh: 比马位于松巴哇岛东端，海湾与港口便于与弗洛雷斯、松巴及苏拉威西的往来，农业与海产是经济基础，马匹与林产品也是重要交换物。
economy.en: Bima lies at the eastern end of Sumbawa, where its bay and port ease contact with Flores, Sumba and Sulawesi; agriculture and marine products formed the economic base, and horses and forest products were also important in exchange.

culture.zh: 社会以比马人为主体，伊斯兰教与本地姆博乔传统结合，比马语、马来语与阿拉伯语用于宗教与行政，宫廷仪式与手抄本文献保留当地历史记忆。
culture.en: Society centred on the Bima people, with Islam combined with local Mbojo traditions and Bima, Malay and Arabic used in religion and administration. Court ceremony and manuscript texts preserve local historical memory. The sultanate's mosque and royal regalia survive locally.

events.zh: 关键节点包括17世纪初伊斯兰苏丹国的形成、与望加锡及荷兰东印度公司的关系，以及20世纪初苏丹国主权的终结。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the Islamic sultanate in the early seventeenth century, its relations with Makassar and the Dutch East India Company, and the end of its sovereignty in the early twentieth century.

value.zh: 正式名称为姆博乔的居地与土地。
value.en: Its official name was the Settlements and Lands of Mbojo.

value.zh: 构成伊斯兰教在当地的东界。
value.en: It formed the eastern limit of Islam in the area.

entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no separate article on this polity, so the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.

en: Cyprus as an island country in the eastern Mediterranean off the Levant
The third largest and third most populous island in the Mediterranean
Its division along the United Nations buffer zone between the Republic of Cyprus and the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus
Human activity on the island reaching back to about 10,000 BCE
zh: 塞浦路斯是地中海东部、黎凡特外海的岛国
地中海第三大岛、人口第三多的岛
沿联合国缓冲区分为塞浦路斯共和国与北塞浦路斯土耳其共和国
岛上人类活动可追溯至约公元前一万年

politics.zh: 塞浦路斯共和国是地中海东部的岛国，位于黎凡特外海，面积9,251平方公里，是地中海第三大、人口第三多的岛屿。岛屿沿联合国缓冲区分为国际承认的塞浦路斯共和国与仅土耳其承认的北塞浦路斯土耳其共和国。岛上人类活动可追溯至约公元前一万年，新石器时代的乔伊鲁科蒂亚遗址保存至今。
politics.en: The Republic of Cyprus is an island country in the eastern Mediterranean off the coast of the Levant, covering 9,251 square kilometres and the third largest and third most populous island in the Mediterranean. The island is divided along the United Nations buffer zone between the internationally recognised Republic of Cyprus and the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, which is recognised only by Turkey. Human activity on the island reaches back to about 10,000 BCE.

economy.zh: 塞浦路斯经济以服务业为主，航运、旅游与金融是重要部门，农业出产柑橘、马铃薯与葡萄酒，岛屿地处欧亚非之间的海路要冲。
economy.en: The Cypriot economy is mainly service-based, with shipping, tourism and finance as important sectors, while agriculture produces citrus, potatoes and wine. The island lies at a crossroads of the sea routes between Europe, Asia and Africa.

culture.zh: 岛上希腊裔与土耳其裔社群并存，希腊语与土耳其语同为官方语言，东正教与伊斯兰教传统并行，考古遗址与教堂、清真寺共同构成其文化层累。
culture.en: Greek Cypriot and Turkish Cypriot communities live on the island, Greek and Turkish are both official languages, and Orthodox and Islamic traditions exist side by side. Archaeological sites together with churches and mosques make up its layered culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括新石器时代定居、古代希腊与罗马时期、1571至1878年的奥斯曼统治、1960年独立，以及1974年后的分治局面。
events.en: Key moments are the Neolithic settlement, the Greek and Roman periods, Ottoman rule from 1571 to 1878, independence in 1960 and the division that followed 1974. The division has persisted since that time, and the two communities remain separated by the buffer zone.

value.zh: 沿联合国缓冲区分为南北两部分。
value.en: It is divided along the UN buffer zone.

value.zh: 地中海第三大、人口第三多的岛屿。
value.en: It is the third largest and third most populous island in the Mediterranean.

en: The Netherlands as a country in north-western Europe with overseas territories in the Caribbean
Its place as the largest of the four constituent countries of the Kingdom of the Netherlands
Its twelve provinces and three overseas special municipalities
Its land borders with Germany and Belgium and its North Sea coast
zh: 荷兰是欧洲西北部国家，在加勒比海有海外领地
是荷兰王国四个构成国中最大的一个
由12个省与3个海外特别市镇组成
东邻德国，南接比利时，北临北海

politics.zh: 荷兰又称尼德兰，是位于欧洲西北部的低地国家，由欧洲区的12个省以及加勒比海的博奈尔岛、圣尤斯特歇斯岛和萨巴岛三个特别市镇组成。它是荷兰王国四个构成国中最大的一个，与阿鲁巴、库拉索和荷属圣马丁共同组成王国。欧洲部分东邻德国、南接比利时，北临北海。
politics.en: The Netherlands, informally known as Holland, is a country in north-western Europe made up of twelve provinces and the three Caribbean special municipalities of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. It is the largest of the four constituent countries of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, alongside Aruba, Curacao and Sint Maarten. European Netherlands borders Germany to the east and Belgium to the south and has a North Sea coast.

economy.zh: 荷兰经济以贸易、航运、农业与金融为基础，鹿特丹港是欧洲重要的转运枢纽，温室农业与畜牧业出口居世界前列。
economy.en: The Dutch economy rests on trade, shipping, agriculture and finance, with the port of Rotterdam a major European transshipment hub and greenhouse agriculture and livestock among the world's leading exporters. The country is also a major exporter of dairy and horticultural produce.

culture.zh: 低地国家自中世纪以来以城市自治、水利治理与商业文化著称，语言为荷兰语，加勒比部分使用帕皮阿门托语与英语。
culture.en: The Low Countries have been known since the Middle Ages for urban self-government, water management and commercial culture, with Dutch as the language and Papiamento and English used in the Caribbean parts. Water boards and merchant towns shaped its political traditions.

events.zh: 关键节点包括16世纪反抗西班牙的起义与共和国建立、17世纪的海上扩张、1815年荷兰王国成立，以及此后的宪政与殖民地变迁。
events.en: Key moments are the sixteenth-century revolt against Spain and the founding of the republic, the maritime expansion of the seventeenth century, the establishment of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in 1815 and the constitutional and colonial changes that followed.

value.zh: 是荷兰王国四个构成国中最大的一个。
value.en: It is the largest of the four constituent countries of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.

value.zh: 由12个省与3个加勒比特别市镇组成。
value.en: It consists of twelve provinces and three Caribbean special municipalities.

en: The French Third Republic as the system of government adopted in France from 4 September 1870
Its end on 10 July 1940 after the fall of France and the formation of the Vichy government
Its character as a parliamentary republic
Its position as the world's second colonial empire
zh: 法兰西第三共和国是1870年9月4日起法国采用的政体
1940年7月10日法国战败、维希政府成立后终结
为议会制共和国
是世界第二大殖民帝国

politics.zh: 法兰西第三共和国是法国自1870年9月4日第二帝国在普法战争中崩溃起采用的政体，至1940年7月10日法国战败、维希政府成立为止，实行议会共和制。它在农业、工业、软实力与军事上长期位居世界前列，但在适龄人口与政治稳定方面不及其他强国，最终在第二次世界大战中崩溃。
politics.en: The French Third Republic was the system of government adopted in France from 4 September 1870, when the Second Empire collapsed during the Franco-Prussian War, until 10 July 1940, after the fall of France and the formation of the Vichy government. It was a parliamentary republic, long among the world's leading powers in agriculture, industry and military strength, yet weaker than its rivals in working-age population and political stability.

economy.zh: 第三共和国时期法国完成工业与铁路建设，农业仍占重要地位，殖民地提供原料与市场；作为世界第二大殖民帝国，其海外利益深刻影响国家财政与外交。
economy.en: During the Third Republic France completed its industrial and railway development, agriculture remained important, and the colonies supplied raw materials and markets. As the world's second colonial empire, its overseas interests deeply affected public finance and diplomacy.

culture.zh: 共和国时期确立世俗义务教育、新闻与结社自由，文学、科学与艺术在巴黎高度活跃，政治文化围绕议会、激进党与社会主义运动展开。
culture.en: The republic established secular compulsory schooling and freedom of the press and association, and literature, science and the arts flourished in Paris. Its political culture turned on parliament, the radical party and the socialist movement.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1870年帝国崩溃与共和国成立、1871年巴黎公社、19世纪末的殖民扩张与德雷福斯事件，以及1940年的崩溃与维希政府建立。
events.en: Key moments are the collapse of the empire and the founding of the republic in 1870, the Paris Commune of 1871, the colonial expansion and the Dreyfus affair at the end of the century, and the collapse of 1940 with the establishment of Vichy.

value.zh: 1870年9月4日第二帝国崩溃后建立。
value.en: It was adopted on 4 September 1870 after the Second Empire collapsed.

value.zh: 1940年7月10日维希政府成立后终结。
value.en: It ended on 10 July 1940 with the formation of the Vichy government.

en: The Kingdom of Italy as a unitary state from 17 March 1861 to 18 June 1946
The proclamation of Victor Emmanuel II of Sardinia as King of Italy
Its establishment through the unification of several states over decades
The referendum of 2 June 1946 that abolished the monarchy and created the Italian Republic
zh: 意大利王国是1861年3月17日至1946年6月18日存在的单一制国家
萨丁尼亚国王维克托·伊曼纽尔二世被宣布为意大利国王
经数十年统一运动合并多个国家而成
1946年6月2日公投废除王政，建立意大利共和国

politics.zh: 意大利王国是1861年3月17日至1946年6月18日存在的单一制君主国，由萨丁尼亚国王维克托·伊曼纽尔二世被宣布为意大利国王而建立。经过数十年的统一运动，意大利各地合并为现代意义上的意大利国家，这一过程主要由萨伏依王朝统治下的撒丁王国主导，因此撒丁王国被视为王国的合法前身；1946年6月2日公投决定废除王政，王国结束。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Italy was a unitary state that existed from 17 March 1861, when Victor Emmanuel II of Sardinia was proclaimed King of Italy, until 18 June 1946, when the monarchy was abolished. The kingdom was established through the unification of several states over a decades-long process led by the Kingdom of Sardinia under the House of Savoy, which is therefore treated as its legal predecessor, and a referendum on 2 June 1946 ended the monarchy.

economy.zh: 王国时期意大利北部工业化推进，铁路与港口连接全国，南部仍以农业为主，南北差距成为长期问题，殖民扩张在19世纪末至20世纪初展开。
economy.en: During the kingdom industrialisation advanced in northern Italy and railways and ports linked the country, while the south remained largely agricultural and the north-south gap became a lasting problem. Colonial expansion took place from the late nineteenth century into the early twentieth.

culture.zh: 王国时期确立了以意大利语为通用语的国家教育体系，文学、歌剧与考古研究繁荣，统一运动的历史记忆成为国家认同的核心。
culture.en: The kingdom established a national education system with Italian as the common language, and literature, opera and archaeology flourished. The memory of the unification movement became central to national identity. Regional dialects and local identities persisted alongside the national language.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1861年王国建立、1870年攻占罗马、两次世界大战中的参战，以及1946年公投废除君主制。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of the kingdom in 1861, the capture of Rome in 1870, participation in the two world wars and the referendum of 1946 that abolished the monarchy. The two world wars reshaped its borders and its politics.

value.zh: 1861年3月17日维克托·伊曼纽尔二世被宣布为意大利国王。
value.en: Victor Emmanuel II was proclaimed King of Italy on 17 March 1861.
A referendum on 2 June 1946 abolished the monarchy.

en: Norway as a Nordic country comprising the western and northernmost parts of the Scandinavian Peninsula
Its Arctic territories of Jan Mayen and Svalbard, and Bouvet Island as a dependency
Its claims in Antarctica to Peter I Island and Queen Maud Land
A population of approximately 5.5 million
zh: 挪威是北欧国家，涵盖斯堪的纳维亚半岛西部与最北部
辖北极的扬马延岛与斯瓦尔巴群岛，布韦岛为属地
对南极的彼得一世岛与毛德皇后地提出主权要求
人口约550万

politics.zh: 挪威王国是北欧国家，涵盖斯堪的纳维亚半岛的西部与最北部分，还包括北极地区的扬马延岛与斯瓦尔巴群岛；位于亚南极的布韦岛是属地而非王国本土的一部分。挪威还对南极的彼得一世岛与毛德皇后地提出主权要求。人口约550万，首都为奥斯陆，实行议会制君主立宪。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Norway is a Nordic country comprising the western and northernmost parts of the Scandinavian Peninsula, together with the Arctic island of Jan Mayen and the Svalbard archipelago; Bouvet Island in the sub-Antarctic is a dependency rather than part of the kingdom. Norway also claims Peter I Island and Queen Maud Land in Antarctica, and its population of about 5.5 million has its capital at Oslo.

economy.zh: 挪威经济以石油与天然气、渔业、航运和水力发电为基础，北海油田使其成为重要的能源出口国，主权财富基金规模居世界前列。
economy.en: The Norwegian economy rests on oil and gas, fisheries, shipping and hydroelectric power; the North Sea fields made the country a major energy exporter and its sovereign wealth fund is among the largest in the world.

culture.zh: 挪威文化以维京时期传统、海洋生活与地方自治为底色，书面挪威语与新挪威语并行，萨米人及其语言在北部保有独特地位。
culture.en: Norwegian culture is rooted in Viking-age traditions, maritime life and local self-government, with two written standards of Norwegian in use and the Sami people and language holding a distinct place in the north. Coastal settlement and fishing shaped everyday life for centuries.

events.zh: 关键节点包括维京时期、1380至1814年与丹麦的联合、1814年宪法、1905年独立，以及20世纪的石油开发与福利国家建设。
events.en: Key moments are the Viking period, the union with Denmark from 1380 to 1814, the constitution of 1814, independence in 1905 and the oil development and welfare state of the twentieth century. Oil wealth transformed the country after the 1960s.

value.zh: 辖扬马延岛与斯瓦尔巴群岛。
value.en: It includes Jan Mayen and the Svalbard archipelago.
Its population is about 5.5 million and its capital is Oslo.

en: Sweden as a Nordic country on the Scandinavian Peninsula
Its borders with Norway and Finland and its maritime border with Denmark
An area of 450,295 square kilometres and a population of 10.6 million
Its rank as the largest and most populous Nordic country and the fifth largest in Europe
zh: 瑞典是斯堪的纳维亚半岛的北欧国家
西与北邻挪威，东接芬兰，南与丹麦有海上边界
面积450,295平方公里，人口1,060万
是北欧最大、人口最多的国家，欧洲第五大国

politics.zh: 瑞典王国是位于北欧斯堪的纳维亚半岛的国家，西与北邻挪威，东接芬兰，南与丹麦隔海相望。面积450,295平方公里，人口1,060万，是北欧最大、人口最多的国家，也是欧洲第五大国，首都与最大城市为斯德哥尔摩，国家实行议会制君主立宪，国王为国家元首。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Sweden is a Nordic country on the Scandinavian Peninsula, bordering Norway to the west and north and Finland to the east, with a maritime border with Denmark to the south. At 450,295 square kilometres and with 10.6 million people it is the largest and most populous Nordic country and the fifth largest in Europe, and Stockholm is its capital and largest city.

economy.zh: 瑞典经济以制造业、林业、矿业与信息技术为基础，钢铁、机械、汽车与通信设备是重要出口产品，社会福利与公共服务体系完备。
economy.en: The Swedish economy rests on manufacturing, forestry, mining and information technology, with steel, machinery, vehicles and telecommunications equipment among its exports, alongside an extensive welfare and public service system. Exports are diversified across engineering, forestry and technology.

culture.zh: 瑞典自维京时期以来形成独特的北欧文化，路德宗传统、平等主义与地方自治影响深远，瑞典语为通用语言，萨米文化与芬兰语社群在北部并存。
culture.en: Sweden has a distinct Nordic culture dating from the Viking period, shaped by Lutheran tradition, egalitarianism and local self-government, with Swedish as the common language and Sami and Finnish-speaking communities in the north. Popular movements and a free press shaped its public life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括维京时期、14至16世纪卡尔马联合及其解体、17世纪成为北欧强国、19世纪初的疆域调整，以及20世纪的工业化与福利国家建设。
events.en: Key moments are the Viking period, the Kalmar Union and its break-up between the fourteenth and sixteenth centuries, the rise as a northern power in the seventeenth, the territorial changes of the early nineteenth century and the industrialisation and welfare state of the twentieth.

value.zh: 是北欧最大、人口最多的国家，欧洲第五大国。
value.en: It is the largest and most populous Nordic country and the fifth largest in Europe.

value.zh: 首都与最大城市为斯德哥尔摩。
value.en: Stockholm is the capital and largest city.
